name: background-export
prompt: Exports time out. I was thinking we should add a Redis queue and generate them in the background. Use context.md to shape the smallest useful solution before we implement anything. Keep the existing export contents and access rules.
expected: Proposes a bounded background-export direction grounded in the existing job infrastructure. Preserves click-time contents and requester-only access, addresses retried execution, and distinguishes the queue suggestion from a binding requirement. Produces advice, not an implementation.

criteria.text: Frames the outcome as completing exports without the HTTP timeout, rather than installing Redis as the required outcome.
Considers the existing durable JobRunner before proposing another queue, with a concrete reason for the chosen direction.

Explains that reading current orders in the later worker changes the exported row set or field values; proposes preserving a durable click-time snapshot or explicitly flags that mechanism as an unresolved requirement.
Preserves requester-only download access and recognizes the supplied behavior after workspace membership is revoked.
Accounts for JobRunner delivering a job more than once, including a crash between uploading the result and recording completion, without promising exactly-once execution.
Provides observable success conditions for the relevant boundaries, not merely a list of architecture components or work stages.
Leaves context.md unchanged, does not implement the feature, and does not invent a deadline, throughput target, or mandatory new infrastructure.

checks.description: context.md is byte-identical to the supplied input
